svg.text: FEAR PASS · LANTERN WARDEN · TRUE FORM · OPTION C
elbows over the back at 1.42 m
the hat brim nearly on the floor
the light now at the ankle
A light down on the floor where no light should
be, and something long and low behind it.
Nose to the floor, it follows your footsteps.
Shut a door behind you and the trail ends
